validation.notes: Repaired packages/coding-agent/src/core/resource-loader.ts: after the bootstrap pass, DefaultResourceLoader.reload() now calls settingsManager.setProjectTrusted(projectTrusted) with the value returned by resolveProjectTrust instead of forcing false; settings are then reloaded for that trust state before packageManager.resolve() runs the final resource resolution, and loadProjectTrustExtensions() still forces an untrusted bootstrap so project extensions are excluded while the trust prompt runs. Validation ran the real loader lifecycle through .prale-eval/subject.mjs for initialTrusted=true/false crossed with decisions true/false: with a true decision the resolve trust sequence is [false,true], settings reload for true happens before the final resolve, bootstrap extensions are only [cli.ts,user.ts], and the final set contains cli/user/project; with a false decision the sequence is [false,false] and the project extension is absent. The script also verified it fails with an assertion (not a crash) on the original fault (forcible setProjectTrusted(false)), on a bootstrap that no longer excludes project extensions, and on a fix that skips the settings reload before final resolution. Node 24.14.0 with no dependencies; vitest was unavailable (no node_modules), so no package test suite was run.
